panels.description: Sitara and Roman stand beside records while Nayah works route line; phone beside Orien rings. Leave upper-right for sound effect.
Sitara answers; Roman watches with treatment file in hand. Leave upper-left for question.
Orien appears only on cracked phone screen, weak and breath-interrupted. Leave upper area for dialogue.
Roman lowers treatment file as call ends; Sitara holds dark phone. Leave upper-left for final line and lower-right for sound effect.

items.speaker: ORIEN
items.text: Croft threatened me. The warnings were scheduled… in case I disappeared.

items.speaker: ORIEN
items.text: Second timestamp. Do not release everything. Release what can be checked.
